experiment: Graft check: trajectory-level CVAE discovery -> causal zhat -> conditioned distillation, on window features built role-style (focal rel-pos/vel windows).

recipe_A_multi_expert.note: zhat perfectly recoverable from observable history (acc 1.00 vs majority 0.33) BUT conditioning does NOT improve BC at the full scale (+3.3% = slightly worse). The discovery+causal parts graft perfectly; the DISTILLATION gain from zhat does NOT appear here.

recipe_D_noise_control.note: single-class conditioning is meaningless (adds capacity only); correctly K=1.

smoke_run_contrast.lesson: small-scale smoke OVERSTATED the conditioning gain (-19.9%); at full scale the gain disappears (+3.3%). Distillation-gain claims need the full sample, not a smoke.

graft_conclusion: The trajectory-level CVAE DISCOVERY + CAUSAL zhat graft onto the role/IQLD pipeline works perfectly on multi-modal data (detect K=3, recover z from history with acc 1.00). But CONDITIONED DISTILLATION shows no gain at full scale (+3.3%): consistent with the whole-session finding that conditioning helps only when z is NOT fully recoverable from the (history-visible) state. Here z IS fully recoverable (acc 1.00) -> conditioning is redundant, mirroring the 3V1/strong-base redundancy. To make conditioning pay, the tactic must be only PARTIALLY observable (POMO-style), not fully readable from history.
